## Verse 1
[G]I wash the cups you left beside the [C]sink
The porch light hums a tune for [D]no one
[G]Rain is tapping softly on the [C]glass
And I count the [D]hours till the [G]morning

## Chorus
[C]Leave it on, leave it [G]on
[D]Somebody might find the way [Em]home
[C]Leave it on, leave it [G]on
[D]I will not be [G]sleeping alone

## Verse 2
[G]Your coat is hanging crooked on the [C]chair
I tell the dog we're [D]fine
[G]He lays his head against my [C]shoe
And we both [D]watch the empty [G]road

## Bridge
[Em]Maybe I am foolish to [C]wait
[G]Maybe the road is [D]long
[Em]But a lamp is a small kind of [C]promise
[D]And I keep it [G]strong
